description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: Used to ensure the idempotency of the request. The parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

descriptions.zh:
### 注意事项
- 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解Elasticsearch产品的收费方式和价格。详情请参见[阿里云Elasticsearch定价](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.7.657d2cbeRoSPCd#/elasticsearch/detail)。
- 创建实例需要通过实名认证。<props="china"><ph>详情请参见[实名认证](~~37175~~)。</ph></props>
- 创建实例时不需要指定可用区，实例默认与所选VPC在同一可用区中。
descriptions.en:
### Precautions
- Before using this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and pricing of Elasticsearch. For more information, see [Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.7.657d2cbeRoSPCd#/elasticsearch/detail).
- Real-name verification is required to create instances.<props="china"><ph> For more information, see [Real-name verification](~~37175~~).</ph></props>
- You do not need to specify a zone when creating an instance. By default, the instance is in the same zone as the selected VPC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch create-instance --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --payment-type postpaid --node-amount 2 --instance-category x-pack --es-admin-password yourPassword --es-version 7.10_with_X-Pack --node-spec disk=20 diskType=cloud_ssd spec=elasticsearch.sn2ne.xlarge --warm-node-configuration amount=3 disk=500 diskType=cloud_efficiency spec=elasticsearch.sn1ne.xlarge --kibana-configuration spec=elasticsearch.sn1ne.large --network-config '{"vswitchId":"vsw-8vbnk6cmurbpump2f0000","vsArea":"cn-zhangjiakou-c","vpcId":"vpc-8vbfu74bmw4m7m84a0000","type":"vpc"}' --description xpack-hot-cold --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
